hypothesis: The exact bidirectional Range Onset route used by the complete-portfolio candidate may provide a stable after-cost edge on BTC or HYPE when its hourly SMA10/30 source is admitted only in completed five-minute RANGE or BREAKOUT states.
decision: Reject the unchanged BTC and HYPE Range Onset mappings from the next executable portfolio revision. BTC lost money over the continuous year on both directions. HYPE was positive in aggregate but failed the pseudo-holdout, its long side was deeply negative, and four short winners carried an unstable result. Preserve both mappings and all fixed-contract outputs as research evidence; do not interpret their configuration presence as evidence of a repeatable bidirectional edge. This record does not mutate active v25.
falsifier: A prospectively declared venue-matched sample with at least 20 independently resolved lifecycles per asset, at least 30 calendar days of coverage, positive after-cost net PnL and profit factor above 1.0 for the combined route and for each direction, and no single trade contributing more than half of gross profit would trigger a new revision. Any evidence hash mismatch invalidates this decision.

metrics.fixed_entry_logic: SMA10/30 cross in completed 5m RANGE or BREAKOUT

limitations: The hourly timeframe was evaluated after sparse live cadence was observed, and the underlying Range Onset rule was originally selected post hoc.
The pseudo-holdout has been reused by prior project research and is not a pristine market-data holdout.
One-minute bar replay cannot establish queue position, sub-bar order, latency, or depth-constrained market impact.
The BTC and HYPE yearly inputs contain 160 and 183 labeled bounded continuity fills respectively; gap-path attribution remains available in the bound reports.

The fixed replay uses 5x leverage, ten percent margin allocation, a 60 bps protective stop, a 48-hour maximum hold, modeled fees and slippage, and official Hyperliquid funding; active live-profile sizing can differ.
No order, close, resize, route filter, restart, or live-profile mutation is authorized by this record.
